title: RAGEvaluationReview
description: Second-line review of the retrieval and grounding evaluation for a RAG-based GenAI use case. Corpus fitness, retrieval quality, grounding evaluation, failure modes, mitigations, monitoring, residual risk, recommended owner actions. Consumed by genai-pre-prod-review, board-ai-risk-pack, ai-governance-reviewer, and the firm's model risk programme.

reviewer_role.description: Function performing the review (e.g., AI Governance Lead, MRMO, second-line model risk).

model_card_id.description: Links to the model-card-builder output when the card is in hand.

validation_plan_id.description: Links to the validation-plan output when the testing block is in hand.

intended_purpose.description: Stated use-case purpose; reliance assertion is judged against this.

corpus_count.description: Number of distinct corpora the retriever indexes.

refresh_cadence_summary.description: One-line summary across corpora; per-corpus cadence lives in corpus_fitness.

scoping_rules.description: Per-user, per-tenant, per-case retrieval scoping rules.

corpus_fitness.description: Per-source enumeration. A 'corpus' that is actually three sources records as three rows.

source.description: Per-source detail. 'Internal policy library' is not enough; name the underlying source system.

freshness.description: Refresh cadence, last refresh, known lag.

coverage_assessment.description: Whether the corpus covers the use case's intended question space; gaps named.

provenance.description: Per-document provenance posture: tagged, untagged, partial; basis.

owner.description: Function owning corpus curation and refresh.

access_controls.description: Retrieval-side access enforcement; pointer to cyber overlay if applicable.

retrieval_quality.description: Retrieval-side metrics. Industry-practice families (RAGAS-style: context precision, context recall) plus latency. Equivalent in-house metrics acceptable when semantics are documented.

metric_definition.description: Plain-language definition of what the metric measures in this implementation.

method.description: How the metric was computed; framework named (e.g., RAGAS, in-house pipeline) with version where relevant.

dataset_ref.description: Test set identifier; for context_recall and refusal-rate the labelled out-of-scope or ground-truth set is required.

segmentation.description: Segments reported (query type, corpus, population). A single number with no segmentation hides systematic failure.

result.description: Headline value; segment-level values land in segmentation_results or in the memo body.

threshold.description: Acceptance threshold tied to the use case's intended purpose.

grounding_evaluation.description: Grounding-side metrics. Industry-practice families (RAGAS-style: faithfulness, answer relevance) plus citation precision and refusal rate on out-of-scope. Equivalent in-house metrics acceptable when semantics are documented.

metric_definition.description: Plain-language definition. Citation precision must be defined as supports-the-claim, not contains-a-marker.

method.description: How the metric was computed; framework named with version where relevant; LLM-judge basis if used.

dataset_ref.description: Test set identifier. Refusal rate requires a labelled out-of-scope set; without it the number is meaningless.

threshold.description: Acceptance threshold tied to the use case's intended purpose.

failure_modes.description: Catalogued failure modes. Baseline set: hallucination, off-corpus answer, citation fabrication, stale-content answer, retrieval bias, cross-scope leakage.

frequency.description: Observed rate, basis (sampled set, monitoring window), or [evidence needed].

example.description: Concrete example anonymised; pattern, not specific facts.

mitigations.description: Controls in place. Each entry needs an evidence pointer; a mitigation without evidence is policy, not a control.

evidence_pointer.description: Config link, test report, change record, or [evidence needed].

exercised_in_test.description: True if at least one evaluation run exercises this mitigation.

monitoring.description: Production signals captured for grounding-relevant events. Each entry has all five fields. User-feedback thumbs alone is insufficient; a ground-truth pipeline at a defined cadence is required.

sampling_cadence.description: Continuous, daily, weekly, monthly, or event-driven.

ground_truth_pipeline.description: How ground truth is established for the signal: sampled adjudication, golden-set replay, SME review, automated scoring.

escalation_path.description: Named committee, officer, or process; CISO function for cyber-tagged signals.

risk.description: Concrete residual risk (e.g., stale-policy answer where the policy library refresh lag exceeds two weeks).

basis.description: One-line basis for the likelihood and impact rating.

accepted_owner_role.description: Role accepting the residual risk; never a named individual.

review_cadence.description: When the acceptance is re-examined (e.g., quarterly, on foundation-model swap, on corpus refresh-cadence change).

depends_on.description: Cross-reference to another recommended action, an upstream artifact, or an external dependency.

source.description: Document, system, person, vendor evidence, or [evidence needed].

sector_overlay_notes.description: Sector-specific fields raised by the loaded sector overlay reference doc.

cross_cutting_overlay_notes.description: Cross-cutting fields raised by the loaded cross-cutting overlay reference doc.

onward_routing.description: AI risk committee, pre-prod gate, MRMO challenge file, exam response file, board pack.
